title: Use byte searches for ASCII CSV quote detection
question: Can ASCII structural-byte searches reduce quote detection cost without changing Unicode behavior?
summary: Use existing byte searches for ASCII delimiters/quotes and retain character matching for Unicode settings.

workloads: Native ordered exports and allocation/shuffle pipelines with rich quoted fields and ordinary probe-v1 controls.

validation.summary: Recorded eight-job comparison retains exact CSV output, independent field/group/cap verification, owner controls and fresh local workflow results.

limitations: Small development cells and uncontrolled cache/background state do not establish general device, shape or tail performance.
Historical percentage gains are not additive; every comparison uses its own pinned baseline.
Standalone predicate assembly justifies a hypothesis; it does not identify production inlined code or function-level CPU cost.
exclusions: Compiler probes and prior quoted-span gains are not additional complete-Run observations.
